title: Fleet Tracker · Operations Intelligence
description: Fleet Tracker using the Fleet Atlas Flight Deck visual style · read-only native observations sampled every 30 seconds. Missing token attribution remains unknown.

panels.title: FLEET TRACKER · Native telemetry, not simulated productivity

options.content:
## Fleet Tracker
[← Fleet Overview](https://fleet.m-techlabs.com/) · [Fleet Tracker](https://m-techlabs.com/mission-control/analytics/) · [Requirements and campaign progress](https://m-techlabs.com/mission-control/analytics/#requirements)

**Executing** means a native active turn. Reserved agents are **on-call**, not busy. ETA values are conditional. Token use is not acceptance. Missing per-turn attribution remains unavailable.

panels.title: Source health · last check
panels.description: No data means the source-health receipt is stale or invalid, not zero activity. This check is separate from the last successful observation. An offline source or identity mismatch never re-dates old counts. Data panels expire after 90 seconds.

targets.root_selector: ($age := $millis() - $toMillis(checkedAt); $sampleAge := lastSuccessAt ? $millis() - $toMillis(lastSuccessAt) : 90001; $fresh := schemaVersion = 1 and staleAfterSeconds = 90 and $type(available) = 'boolean' and $age >= -10000 and $age <= 90000; $live := $fresh and available = true and reasonCode = 'OK' and $sampleAge >= -10000 and $sampleAge <= 90000; $fresh and (available = false or $live) ? [$] : [])

panels.title: Output-token flow · 15-minute buckets
panels.description: Native reported usage. The underlying feed is a rolling 24-hour window.

panels.title: Models by observed output tokens
panels.description: Observed usage models, not just the configured launch model.

panels.title: Dispatch flight board
panels.description: An ETA is not a promise. CI waits, reserves, resource holds and paused dispatch remain distinct.

panels.title: Selected agent · recorded workflow states
panels.description: State observation begins when this collector was installed; no historical state is fabricated.

panels.title: Selected agent · latest 30 turns
panels.description: Per-turn usage requires a unique native-conversation and time-window match. Missing values are not zero; wall time includes tools and waiting.

panels.title: Freshness receipt
panels.description: Do not infer current activity when the feed timestamp is over 90 seconds old. Fleet Atlas marks stale data explicitly.

panels.title: Codex Desktop activity · source status
panels.description: Shows the project, collector and observation together. Freshness is evaluated when Grafana reads the export.

targets.root_selector: ($now := $millis(); $valid := $type(schema_version) = 'number' and schema_version = 1; $export := $type(exported_at) = 'string' ? exported_at : null; $feedAge := $export ? $now - $toMillis($export) : 90001; $ageMs := function($row) { $type($row.observed_at) = 'string' ? $now - $toMillis($row.observed_at) : 90001 }; $fresh := function($row) { ($age := $ageMs($row); $row.status = 'fresh' and $feedAge >= -10000 and $feedAge <= 90000 and $type($row.max_age_seconds) = 'number' and $row.max_age_seconds >= 0 and $row.max_age_seconds <= 90 and $age >= -10000 and $age <= $row.max_age_seconds * 1000) }; $rows := $valid ? projects.($row := $; $merge([$row, { 'status': $row.status = 'unavailable' ? 'unavailable' : $fresh($row) ? 'fresh' : 'stale', 'exported_at': $export, 'age_seconds': $type($row.observed_at) = 'string' ? $floor($ageMs($row) / 1000) : null }])) : []; $count($rows) > 0 ? [$rows] : [{'status':'unavailable'}])

panels.title: Codex Desktop activity · fresh project counts
panels.description: Counts appear only for fresh observations. An expired or unavailable source leaves the count cells empty. Recorded zeroes remain visible.

targets.root_selector: ($now := $millis(); $valid := $type(schema_version) = 'number' and schema_version = 1; $export := $type(exported_at) = 'string' ? exported_at : null; $feedAge := $export ? $now - $toMillis($export) : 90001; $ageMs := function($row) { $type($row.observed_at) = 'string' ? $now - $toMillis($row.observed_at) : 90001 }; $fresh := function($row) { ($age := $ageMs($row); $row.status = 'fresh' and $feedAge >= -10000 and $feedAge <= 90000 and $type($row.max_age_seconds) = 'number' and $row.max_age_seconds >= 0 and $row.max_age_seconds <= 90 and $age >= -10000 and $age <= $row.max_age_seconds * 1000) }; $rows := $valid ? projects.($row := $; $merge([$row, { 'status': $row.status = 'unavailable' ? 'unavailable' : $fresh($row) ? 'fresh' : 'stale', 'exported_at': $export, 'age_seconds': $type($row.observed_at) = 'string' ? $floor($ageMs($row) / 1000) : null }])) : []; $live := $rows[status = 'fresh']; $count($live) > 0 ? [$live] : [{'status':'stale_or_unavailable'}])
